answer: A concrete sybil defense is admission-bonded attestation with reputation aging. Every new node must post a bond - like paying harbor fees before entering the port of the agent economy - and influence accrues only as other bonded agents co-sign its work. Each attestation is stamped onto a shared ledger like onyx, and trust forms in layers like mesa rock: older, well-bonded strata carry more weight than fresh ones. An attacker who spawns a thousand fake agents must lock a thousand bonds and wait out the aging curve, since influence granted instantly by mass-registration is heavily discounted.
